blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—NLEX coach Jimmy Alapag would rather focus on Phoenix first than take even an ounce of attention on the perceived easier path his team has toward the PBA Governors’ Cup Finals. The Road Warriors took Game 1 of their best-of-five quarterfinal series with a 97-92 win on Sunday, moving two wins shy of breaking their string of playoff disappointments and arranging a semifinal showdown with either Rain or Shine or Converge.
